newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X did hold 90 pct Busang before deal.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X did hold 90 pct Busang before deal.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd confirmed on Friday that it held 90 percent of the rich Busang gold property prior to signing a joint venture deal with Freeport McMorRan Copper & Gold Inc this week.
Bre-X said it was asked by the Ontario Securities Commission and Toronto Stock Exchange to clarify certain remarks made by senior officers of the company.

The company also said that a remark by vice-chairman John Felderhof that he would "feel very comfortable with a potential of 200 million ounces" should not be interpreted as an increased resource calculation for Busang.
To confirm any increased resource calculation, a longer-term drilling program will be necessary and there can be no assurances as to the results of such a program.
"John Felderhof and the Bre-X technical team have been, to date, accurate in their projections," chairman and chief executive David Walsh said in a statement.

Bre-X said it agreed on February 17 to drop its holding to 45 percent "in order to satisfy the national interest of the people of Indonesia, to ensure the expeditious development of the Busang Gold Project and to include FCX as a partner responsible for the development and operation of the project."
The company said it was "gratified" by Freeport's involvement in Busang and its 30 years of experience operating in Indonesia.
